evidence.excerpt: The project develops and validates a revenue management decision-support toolkit tailored to independently owned accommodation businesses in the Pannonian region. Core activities include assembly of a multi-year daily rate and occupancy panel from partner hotels and rental properties, estimation of asymmetric demand models that distinguish high-side and low-side forecast errors, and design of rule-based pricing triggers suitable for operators without dedicated revenue management staff. Fieldwork involves structured interviews with 80 accommodation managers and a randomised advisory intervention with 22 willing participants. Deliverables include an open-access dataset, a calibrated forecasting module, and a practitioner handbook distributed through the Tourism Organisation of Vojvodina.
